rules.statement: The best evidence of a Kandyan marriage is the registration entry in the Register of Marriages, and oral evidence cannot be used to prove the nature of the marriage if it is not registered.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 39 of the Amended Kandyan Marriage Ordinance (No. 3 of 1870) enacts that the entry in the register shall be the best evidence' of the marriage contracted and the other facts stated therein. The expression 'best evidence' is used in the sense which belongs to it in the English Law. It is the essence of 'best evidence' according to English Law that it excludes all evidence of an inferior character."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 39 of Ordinance No. 3 of 1870, the best evidence of the marriage.
